product_metadata.title: Bathroom Runner Rug, Non Slip Pink Bath Mat Plush Bathroom Rugs, Washable Long Carpet Bath Rugs for Bathroom (Lovely Pink, 59'' x 20'')
features: Incredibly Soft pink rugs for bathroom with plush microfiber and heavy duty rubber backing,super fluffy and comfortable, just like stepping on a cloud and you will love the feeling under your bare feet after showering.
Absorbent runner bathroom rug like a big sponge in your bathroom and keep the floor dry all the day, can soak up the water quickly while stepping out of the bath, shower, or going to the sink.
Non Slip pink runner rug with heavy duty slip-resistant TPR, keeps the bathroom rugs mats long lasting and more durable, Please place the bathroom mat on clean dry smooth floor only for the safe.
Pink bath runner with neutral size (59 x 20 inch) is big enough for sink, bathtub or shower with beautiful pink color, bring charming and fantastic feeling for your bathroom.

SHEEPPING long pink bathroom runner is easy to clean,machine wash separately in cold water using mild detergent. Use only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry on low setting and shake to restore fluff.
